# OnSIDES v3.1.1 later label slice (generated by experiments/build_onsides_reports.py)

Data release 2026-04-22 (CC BY 4.0). One report per deduplicated label statement (ingredient, target symptom, MedDRA term, label section, country); the bridge routes, the report schema, the qualification rule and the label-section semantics are specified in docs/onsides_label_slice_spec.md. Statements: 5959 (5649 PT-coded, 310 LLT-coded and matched through the PT their LLT falls under); qualifying reports (the SIDER rule: single mechanism target and an ATC N code; target gene in the graph; at least one single-ingredient label): 1144 from 127 ingredients and 123 perturbations (102 shared with SIDER, 21 OnSIDES-only). Disqualified statements by reason: {'no_single_mechanism_target': 2125, 'no_chembl_parent': 479, 'atc_not_nervous_system': 1985, 'combination_label_only': 96, 'no_atc_code': 130}; statements of ingredients without a bridge entry: 0.

Label sections exist for US labels only (AR, BW, WP); every UK, EU and JP event carries label_section NA, OnSIDES' value for the undivided non-US label, coded non_us_label_section and counted as adverse-reactions text by rubric_adverse_reactions_section.

MedDRA term names are not reproduced here; identifiers and target symptoms only.

## Pair-level overlap with the SIDER drug pairs

Against the qualified SIDER-label pairs of the assembled table (relation induces, the pairs of SIDER drugs that passed SIDER's ChEMBL mapping, single-target and ATC N rules): pairs in both 283; SIDER only (on 2015 labels, absent from current labels or from the OnSIDES extraction) 260; OnSIDES pairs absent from the qualified table 304. Of those, 204 are on 2015 SIDER labels (a PT event of SIDER 4.1 for a SIDER identifier linked to the perturbation, independent of SIDER's qualification) and 100 are candidates for the later slice (41 on perturbations SIDER also holds, 59 on OnSIDES-only perturbations); a candidate may still have been on a 2015 label that SIDER's extraction missed.

## Design document changes to apply

4.2 (E2, both slices): SIDER 4.1 supplies the 2015 label slice and OnSIDES v3.1.1 the current-label slice; both are grade B label evidence under one qualification rule (single mechanism target, ATC N code), OnSIDES without frequencies but with the label section, the extraction score, the label count and the country as rubric features; ingredients are unified with SIDER drugs through the ChEMBL parents of SIDER's stereo-flattened identifiers or by drug name, so both sources report on one perturbation.
6.1 (pharmacological time split): SIDER 2015 pairs train; the 100 later-slice candidates test (OnSIDES pairs absent from the qualified SIDER table and from the raw SIDER 4.1 label events of the linked identifiers), with the caveat that a candidate may have existed on a 2015 label that SIDER missed; the 204 pairs absent from the qualified table but on 2015 labels are not test positives; OnSIDES rows are dated by the release (an upper bound).
10 (layout): data/processed/onsides/onsides_reports.parquet; mechanistic_pathway_learning/evidence/load_onsides_label_events.py, onsides_identifier_bridge.py; experiments/fetch_onsides_identifier_bridge.py, build_onsides_reports.py; docs/onsides_label_slice_spec.md.
12 (status): the counts above.
